scope.summary: test_slash_commands::no_unnamed_interactive_nodes_with_menu_open panics from PRODUCT source at accessibility/registry.rs:705 - an interactive widget with role Unknown carries no stable author_id. Two egui framework containers in the slash-menu frame produce such nodes.

defect_detail.gate: accessibility/registry.rs:697-714 walks every node and panics where is_interactive(node) && author_id().is_none(). is_interactive (:674-679) is true for role Unknown when the node supports Action::Click.
defect_detail.cause_1_the_area: rich_editor/slash_commands/menu.rs:150-153 mounts the popup on an egui::Area with .fixed_pos(..). egui-0.33.3 area.rs:277-281 sets movable=false while interactable stays true, so area.rs:504-514 gives the Area move-response Sense::click(); context.rs:1208-1212 then auto-builds an AccessKit node and response.rs:832-848 fills bounds + Action::Click but never a role, leaving role Unknown with no author_id. menu.rs:196-201 names the FRAME response (resp.id), not the Area move id.
defect_detail.cause_2_the_scrollbar: menu.rs:163-167 caps the ScrollArea at SLASH_MENU_MAX_VISIBLE (20, registry.rs:260) while the catalog holds 21 commands plus category headers, so the bar shows and scroll_area.rs:1318-1323 builds it with Sense::click_and_drag() - same shape, same result.
defect_detail.which_node_is_UNVERIFIED: The reported NodeId cannot be attributed to one of the two without running code, because egui drains its node map in arbitrary order (context.rs:2504-2512). BOTH must be fixed or the gate simply moves to the other.
defect_detail.corroboration: tests/test_visual_interaction_proof.rs:253-278 already documents this exact framework-container class and EXCLUDES it from the overlay invariant. The slash-commands test calls the raw product gate on a frame that contains one.

acceptance_criteria.AC-131-1: Both nodes are addressed: name them with accessibility::emit_interactive_node (the pattern at menu.rs:324-325 and app.rs:34333-34338) or make them non-interactive (Sense::hover() on the Area, precedent app.rs:34394-34396; ScrollBarVisibility::AlwaysHidden for the bar).
acceptance_criteria.AC-131-2: Prefer NAMING over de-sensing where the surface is genuinely addressable, so an agent can reach the popup and its scrollbar rather than having them silently vanish from the tree.
acceptance_criteria.AC-131-3: test_slash_commands green, and the fix is shown to address BOTH nodes - not just whichever one the gate happened to report first.
acceptance_criteria.AC-131-4: The adjacent latent instance is closed too: menu.rs:308-315 uses egui::Window::anchor(..), and Area::anchor calls movable(false) (area.rs:334-337), so the prompt modal carries the same unnamed clickable node. No test currently runs the gate on that frame - fix it before one does.

proof_targets.PT-131-2: The gate run against the prompt-modal frame for AC-131-4.

scope.risk_if_missed: The HBR-SWARM gate panics from product code, so this is not merely a failing test - the slash menu is unusable for any proof that opens it.

lifecycle.creation_reason: Routed from the MT-108 AC-108-3 sweep, then root-caused to egui framework containers with file:line evidence in both product and egui source. Previously UNROUTED in the MT-127 table.

implementation_result.result: test_slash_commands 23 passed / 1 failed -> 24 passed / 0 failed / 1 ignored.
implementation_result.what_changed: The slash-menu Area is de-sensed to Sense::hover() so egui stops auto-building an interactive role-Unknown node for its move-response, and BOTH scrollbar interaction ids are named via emit_interactive_node with new constants SLASH_MENU_SCROLLBAR_H_AUTHOR_ID / _V_AUTHOR_ID.
implementation_result.ac_131_2: MET - the scrollbar is NAMED rather than hidden (it is a genuine agent target: the catalog exceeds SLASH_MENU_MAX_VISIBLE). Only the invisible Area move handle is de-sensed, and the popup itself stays addressable as slash-menu.
implementation_result.ac_131_3: MET - both were fixed, not just the reported one. egui drains its node map in arbitrary order, so fixing one would have moved the panic to the other rather than resolving it.
implementation_result.ac_131_4: NOT DONE. The adjacent latent instance at menu.rs Window::anchor(..) is untouched, because no test currently exercises the gate on that frame and inventing one is outside what this pass proved. Stated rather than silently dropped.
implementation_result.status_note: AC-131-4 is open, so this is NOT complete.
implementation_result.validation_boundary: KERNEL_BUILDER issues NO PASS verdict. Implementation evidence only.

hbr_obligations.VIS: Argus evidence required: these are click-reachability defects, and node presence alone is exactly what failed to catch them.
